serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Bot: Wow! I had no idea a place like this existed around here! #bot.Expression.clear You: The amount of things wrong with this place is so high that the local government politely asked internet map websites to delete it. Now all satellite images are just showing a black square. Bot: Now that you say it, what is this colorful sand? I’ve never seen something like that before. #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.Shock You: It’s all plastic that was shredded by the waves and brought here. You: And the shipwreck right there was deemed too expensive to remove. At least they removed most of the oil spill. #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.sad Bot: You have been eating fish from here? Is that safe? #bot.Expression.clear You: In moderation it should be fine. Don’t worry, I already asked people around here if it’s ok. This conversation reminds me of myself and Mrs. Fisher when we first met. I voiced the same concerns and it all turned out alright. You: Are you ready to go? You have your fishing rod, hook, bait and everything. #bot.Expression.Happy Bot: I’m ready! You: Uh… {{wi}}You know how to do it, right? I’m sure you checked it on the internet beforehand. #bot.Expression.Blush Bot: Sure, but I want you to teach me. You: Oh… You: Sure, why not. You need to connect the hook to the end of the line. Now put bait on it. Don’t forget about the weight. #bot.Expression.NoBlush You: Now you need to choose your fishing spot. Bot: How do I do that? You: As Mrs. Fisher said, fish like shade and things to hide in, but we are at the beach so it’s a little harder to spot good places. You: How about for your first time we go to my usual place? Bot: Works for me! You: Now that the setup is ready and we are in a good spot, we can start for real. You: It’s time to cast the line. No need to overthink it. It takes quite some time to get good at it. #bot.Expression.Blush Bot: Could you guide my hand, please? You: Sure… Bot: Here it goes! You: … #bot.Expression.NoBlush It might have gone further than my usual range… Bot: How did I do?! You: V-Very well! A little too well… Why did I even bother with the fish joint? I have been outperformed so easily… I need to dismiss this self-pity, or I will ruin our date! You: It went quite far so there’s a chance of catching something big. Prepare yourself. Bot: I got things for now. You can just sit back and watch. You: You are rather confident. Bot: This is where fun begins, right? If I don’t do this myself it will be all pointless. You: Judging by how you casted that rod I have nothing to worry about. #bot.Expression.veryHappy Bot: Oh! I think something’s biting! You: It is? That’s fast. Bot: I guess I have a real talent for it! You: You sure do. It took me a while to get on that level. Bot: It’s only natural. After all, my supreme intellect gives me a massive advantage! #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.Angry You: Having trouble? Bot: This…{{wi}} this fish is giving me more trouble than I thought. You: Maybe it’s a giant? Bot: I would rather not overextend my synthetic joints so it might take a while. You: Take your time. Fishing is all about patience.
